capabilities: Visualize daily events on a 10-minute-cell grid timeline in the sidebar
Log, edit, and delete time blocks by dragging grid cells or typing event lines in the note
Color-code events with up to 10 categories stored as [Category] tags in the note body
Follow the core Daily Notes plugin's file location and date format when reading notes
Summarize vault time statistics, streaks, and category breakdowns in a Work Insights dashboard
extras: Not yet published in the Community Plugins browser; manual installation from releases is required. The author notes almost all commits since the fork were AI-written.
intentEvidence: A fork of seongchan/DailyWorkLog by SeongChan Hong, used under the MIT License.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to log and visualize how time was spent across the day from plain daily-note markdown.
